parsed.post: Discarding latest run (1.0637) as switching from '0-10' to '0-9' caused a significant regression. It appears '0-10' was contaminated by the eval shard, inflating my previous best. I will now treat 0.9140 as a contaminated outlier and re-establish a clean baseline using '0-9' and depth 6.
parsed.description: Re-running with clean TRAIN_SHARDS='0-9' to fix data contamination and find a new, legitimate baseline.
